factors.name: fertility

factors.name: drainage

It measures robustness to input uncertainty, NOT validated map accuracy.

factors.name: legal_environmental_restriction
factors.unit: share of polygon area under mapped restriction
factors.note: mapped restriction type(s): built-up land (OpenStreetMap/WorldCover; not the official WDPA/cadastre)

factors.name: slope
factors.note: Terrain slope: polygon mean 11.50 deg (mean/P90 blend); rating 35/100 (severity 3); 96% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: irreversible; source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (~30 m); irreversible at >16 deg (N2); 9-16 deg needs terracing

factors.name: stoniness
factors.note: Coarse fragments (0-60 cm): polygon mean 16.85 vol%; rating 83/100 (severity 1); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: irreversible; source: SoilGrids 2.0 cfvo (~250 m); stone content >75 vol% = N2

factors.name: water_holding
factors.note: Plant-available water capacity: polygon mean 12.59 cm/m; rating 93/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: Saxton-Rawls PTF on SoilGrids sand/clay/SOC/CFVO (~250 m); computed pedotransfer estimate, not measured

factors.name: salinity
factors.note: Soil salinity (ECe): polygon mean 2.24 dS/m; rating 82/100 (severity 1); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: SOTWIS Jordan 1:500 000 map unit (topsoil 0-20 cm) (~5000 m); legacy survey estimate per map unit; coarse

factors.name: sodicity
factors.note: Sodicity (ESP): polygon mean 1.00 %; rating 98/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: SOTWIS Jordan (~5000 m); classes after FAO Soils Bulletin 55 Table 39

factors.name: gypsum
factors.note: Gypsum content: polygon mean 1.00 g/kg; rating 99/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: SOTWIS Jordan (~5000 m); gypsic horizon (>500 g/kg) treated as irreversible

factors.name: carbonate
factors.note: Calcium carbonate equivalent: polygon mean 40.00 g/kg; rating 98/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: SOTWIS Jordan (~5000 m); lenient: FAO gives no critical limit; Jordan soils are calcareous

factors.name: soil_reaction
factors.note: Soil pH: polygon mean 7.79 pH (H2O); rating 100/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: reversible; source: SoilGrids 2.0 phh2o 0-30 cm (~250 m)

factors.name: fertility
factors.note: Fertility (SOC, CEC): polygon mean 19.00 g/kg SOC; rating 100/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: reversible; source: SoilGrids 2.0 soc, cec 0-30 cm (~250 m); capped at S3: amendable with organic matter/fertiliser

factors.name: drainage
factors.note: Soil drainage class: polygon mean 5.00 ordinal 1(very poor)-7(excessive); rating 100/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: SOTWIS Jordan (~5000 m)

factors.name: water_supply
factors.note: Rainfall (moisture supply): polygon mean 244.00 mm/yr; rating 49/100 (severity 2); 100% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: irreversible; source: WorldClim 2.1 precipitation normals 1970-2000 (~1000 m); <100 mm/yr: no rainfed cropping; irrigation water source not evaluated (no groundwater layer)

factors.name: temperature
factors.note: Temperature (frost / heat): polygon mean 9.56 degC coldest-month Tmin; rating 72/100 (severity 1); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: irreversible; source: TerraClimate 1991-2020 (downscaled WorldClim pattern) (~4000 m)

factors.name: ml_cultivation_likelihood
factors.note: probability that land with these terrain/soil/climate conditions is cultivated in Jordan today (spatially cross-validated LightGBM ensemble, isotonic-calibrated); NOT a suitability probability

factors.name: observed_cultivation_2021
factors.note: mean of ESA WorldCover 2021 and Impact Observatory 2021 cropland fractions (land-cover products, not field survey)

label_basis.1: rule-derived (FAO-style limiting-factor evaluation) + ML cultivation-likelihood evidence; never field-verified
label_basis.2: rule-derived + ML evidence; includes land observed under cultivation in 2021 (observed, WorldCover+IO LULC)
label_basis.3: rule-derived: reversible/partially reversible severe limitation(s); feasibility NOT assessed here (see Model 2)
label_basis.4: rule-derived: irreversible limitation (steepness, stoniness, hyper-aridity <100 mm/yr, gypsic, temperature) or ML-unsupported
